concerns.text: Task T001 specifies that the quick‑start command `python -m pipeline.run --sample 100` will create `data/results/sample_output.parquet`, but the rest of the pipeline writes result artifacts under the `results/` directory (e.g., `results/ingestion_coverage.json`). The mismatched output path makes the verification step ambiguous and likely to fail because the expected file location does not exist.
